paragraphs: Rabbi Yannai, son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder’s son, in Rabbi Yannai Rabbah’s name: end of Megillah 32a. Nedarim 25a as printed (the matching passage is 22a): the son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder’s daughter came before Rabbi Yannai Rabbah.
